title: Pachakuti & Andean Reciprocal Justice (Ayni)
summary: Guaman Poma de Ayala's Andean political ontology combining Pachakuti (the cyclical cosmic turnover, revolution, and restoration of space-time balance) with Ayni (the sacred Andean principle of reciprocal, symmetrical exchange between communities and the cosmos). Guaman Poma demonstrated that Spanish colonial extractivism violently inverted the moral universe into 'a world turned upside down', mandating a restorative cosmic and political transformation.
